anchors.subject: STATE_PREDICATE_REGISTRY
anchors.constraint: STATE_PREDICATE_REGISTRY is the live predicate vocabulary; a marker for a struck entry is RED
anchors.invalidate: a marker for a struck registry entry is not rejected

anchors.subject: resolveReuse
anchors.constraint: registry `reuse` pointers wire the env sources by name; an unresolvable spec degrades the source
anchors.invalidate: an unresolvable reuse spec leaves the env source alive

anchors.subject: STATE_BARE_RES
anchors.constraint: the bare-word scan derives from the live predicate set; a struck predicate escapes the scan
anchors.invalidate: a struck predicate still flags in prose (second hard-coded list)

anchors.subject: CODE_GROUPS
anchors.constraint: every exported `*_CODES` vocabulary is registered in CODE_GROUPS

anchors.subject: checkVerbatimClaim
anchors.constraint: verbatim `reauthored` is a recount of `reanchor_log`, not a flag
anchors.invalidate: a declared recount mismatching reanchor_log passes the claims leg
